en.name: Hikvision 4-Camera CCTV Kit
en.shortDescription: Complete 4-camera kit: NVR, four 4MP bullet cameras, cables and power supply.
en.description:
## Hikvision 4-Camera CCTV Kit

Everything needed for a small shop or home: a 4-channel NVR, four 4MP bullet cameras, pre-made cables and a power supply, ready to install.

- 4× 4MP PoE bullet cameras, 30m night vision
- 4-channel NVR with 1 TB drive included
- 60m of Cat5e cable included
